segments.name: Growth Lending
segments.description: A specialty finance company providing senior secured loans and equity financing to high growth-potential companies in technology, healthcare, business services and other industries.
segments.evidence: We are a specialty finance company focused on providing senior secured loans to high growth-potential companies in technology, healthcare, business services, financial services, select consumer services and products and other high-growth industries.

revenueModel.text: The company earns current income from interest on its loan portfolio and, secondarily, capital gains on warrants and other equity positions in its portfolio companies.
revenueModel.evidence: Our investment objective is to maximize our total return to our stockholders primarily through current income on our loan portfolio, and secondarily through capital gains on our warrants and other equity positions.

changes.text: In 2021, the company changed its name from Runway Growth Credit Fund Inc. to Runway Growth Finance Corp.
changes.evidence: On August 18, 2021, we changed our name to "Runway Growth Finance Corp." from "Runway Growth Credit Fund Inc."
